title: Seacrest Beach "30A State of Mine" 8377 E Co Hwy 30A Unit 101
h1: Seacrest Beach "30A State of Mine" 8377 E Co Hwy 30A Unit 101
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Steps from the beach- 3 adult bikes- Resort-Style Amenities at Waterhouse Complex- Rooftop pool and hot tub- Community private beach access- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: 30A State of Mind is a dreamy 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom condo that sleeps 10 in the Seacrest Beach community off of Scenic 30A. Enjoy resort-style amenities at the Waterhouse Complex, including a Gulf-view rooftop pool deck with grills and a sitting spa, a fitness center, steam room, and private deeded beach access only steps away from the condo. Guests will love the private patio with garden views, spacious accommodations, and the 3-minute walk to the beach.Step into this stunning condo and be greeted by natural light streaming through the expansive windows and doors, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere in the great room. The plush furnishings, including a queen sleeper sofa, provide comfort, while the 55" TV provides entertainment. Take in garden views from the spacious private patio, perfect for relaxation and enjoyment. A professionally designed kitchen showcases a multitude of upgrades, including beautiful granite countertops, an eye-catching backsplash, and high-end Viking appliances. The breakfast bar comfortably seats 5 for a casual meal, while the traditional dining table accommodates 8 with a mix of chair and bench seating. For added convenience, there's a laundry room down the hallway. When it's time to turn in for the night, guests can unwind in 3 cozy bedrooms. The primary bedroom offers a royal experience with a king-sized bed and a luxurious private bathroom with a walk-in shower and separate soaking tub. Plus, access to the rear patio for a breath of fresh air. A well-appointed guest bedroom provides a full-sized bed and a private bathroom. The bunk room boasts a twin-over-twin bed and a full-over-full bed, perfect for younger guests or those young at heart. All 3 bedrooms include a TV for entertainment.30A State of Mind is a ground-floor corner unit with modern amenities in a coveted beach location. With on-site parking for 2 vehicles—plus 3 adult bikes—it's easy to explore the local area. Beach access is directly across the street. Don't wait! Book 30A State of Mind now by calling Callista by 360 Blue!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/ Jacuzzi Tub SeparateGuest Bedroom: Full Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: Twin/Twin and Full/Full Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and Callista Vacation Rentals fines.*This property has a strict non-smoking policy. Violation of this policy puts the guest at risk of being fined and/or evicted.*Beach chair service is available at cost to the guests from March 1st to November 15th.
